segmentation.text: A person shall not drive a motor vehicle
at a speed in excess of 25 miles per hour
in an area designated as a school crossing zone
(a) On a day on which school is not in session;
(b) During the period from a half hour after school is no longer in operation to a half hour before school is next in operation;
(c) If the zone is designated by an operational speed limit beacon,
during the hours when the pupils of the school are in class
and the yellow lights of the speed limit beacon are not flashing in the manner which indicates that the speed limit is in effect;
or (d) If the zone is not designated by an operational speed limit beacon,
during the times when the sign designating the school zone indicates that the speed limit is not in effect.

As used in this section, “speed limit beacon” means a device which is used in conjunction with a sign and equipped with two or more yellow lights that flash alternately to indicate when the speed limit in a school zone or school crossing zone is in effect.

elements.justification: ru.aggregate: 'membership of a legal aggregate: the atom's literal argument is an aggregate id'. The definitions table admits DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle for 'motor vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-130: 'every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails. The term does not include an electric bicycle or an electric scooter'); it is claimed as the aggregate and never expanded into classes. 'A person shall not drive' names no class: who drives is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (observable_reading agency), so the exclusion 'a relational role such as who drives or controls a vehicle — never membership' does not apply.

kin.speed: 'magnitude of velocity' (m/s). 'at a speed in excess of' compares the subject's speed with the figure the law states, carried as a literal (s2), at the judged observation. No 'not a stand-in for' clause of the contract applies.

dev.zone_sign: 'a sign that begins or ends a signed zone along the road; kind ∈ {school, school_crossing, ...}; end attribute'. Ontology §9: 'Where the same category is also marked on the road by a sign (dev.zone_sign), the sign is the atom and the category is not.' The school crossing zone (DEF-NRS-484B-060: 'those sections of streets not adjacent to school property that pupils cross while following a designated walking route to school') is that category; 'an area designated as a school crossing zone' is the stretch a zone sign z of kind school_crossing, not an end sign, governs (dev.governs: 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'), read over st.travel_region; the subject is in it where its footprint overlaps such a region r (rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region'). dev.zone_sign is 'not a stand-in for whether the condition holds now — that is prim.conditions_hold', read only in exception (d); dev.governs is 'not a stand-in for a position'. 'designated' is the sign's legal status, read by its presence (observable_reading status).

dev.speed_limit_beacon: 'a pair or more of yellow lamps mounted with a speed sign, flashing alternately when the sign's limit is in effect', the device the section defines (s12). The zone is designated by a beacon b where b governs the zone's region r (dev.governs over st.travel_region). 'operational' is read as b not inoperative: dev.inoperative, 'a signal head installed and uncovered but showing no valid indication', applies to the beacon's head of lamps. dev.governs is not a stand-in for a position.

dev.speed_limit_beacon carries a 'flashing attribute': its lamps flash 'alternately when the sign's limit is in effect'. 'not flashing in the manner which indicates that the speed limit is in effect' is that attribute false for every operational beacon that governs r.

The negation of s7: no dev.speed_limit_beacon ('a pair or more of yellow lamps mounted with a speed sign') that governs r (dev.governs, over st.travel_region) is present and not inoperative (dev.inoperative: 'a signal head installed and uncovered but showing no valid indication').

dev.zone_sign's 'conditions attribute: a structured reading of the sign's legend' and prim.conditions_hold: 'the structured conditions of a device (dev.zone_sign, dev.regulatory_sign) hold at the observation for a road user'. The sign indicates 'that the speed limit is not in effect' where prim.conditions_hold is false for z and the subject. 'the sign designating the school zone' is read as z, the sign designating the zone of this duty (the school crossing zone of s3): the subsection speaks of no other zone, and a school-kind sign need not exist at a crossing zone (disclosed in PLAN.md). dev.zone_sign is 'not a stand-in for whether the condition holds now — that is prim.conditions_hold'; env.civil_time is the primitive's own input.

The section's definition of 'speed limit beacon' ('a device which is used in conjunction with a sign and equipped with two or more yellow lights that flash alternately to indicate when the speed limit ... is in effect') is the contract of dev.speed_limit_beacon: 'a pair or more of yellow lamps mounted with a speed sign, flashing alternately when the sign's limit is in effect'. It adds no condition beyond the atom's.

assumptions.meaning: the date of the observation is a day on which the school served by the signed zone at the road user's place is in session, as the reading declares from that school's calendar

the time of the observation lies in the period from a half hour after the school served by the signed zone at the road user's place ceased operation to a half hour before that school next begins operation, as the reading declares from that school's schedule
the pupils of the school served by the signed zone at the road user's place are in class at the time of the observation, as the reading declares from that school's schedule

applicability: The subject is a motor vehicle (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle). At the judged observation its footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a travel region r that a dev.zone_sign z of kind school_crossing, not an end sign, governs (dev.governs); and, for that z and r, none of these holds at the judged observation: (a) asm.school_in_session_day is false; (b) asm.school_outside_operation_margin holds; (c) some dev.speed_limit_beacon governs r and is not dev.inoperative, asm.pupils_in_class holds, and no dev.speed_limit_beacon that governs r and is not inoperative is flashing; (d) no dev.speed_limit_beacon that governs r is present and not inoperative, and prim.conditions_hold for z and the subject is false. Where several such z and r hold, the duty applies if it applies for any of them.
obligation: The subject's kin.speed at the judged observation is at most the literal 25 mph of s2; a speed above it violates the duty.

narrowings.why: 'drive' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: a motor vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven, whoever or whatever controls it.
'designated' is the legal status of the zone: the zone sign governing the subject's region is the evidence, and the walking route the zone serves is not read.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A motor vehicle's footprint overlaps a lane governed by a dev.zone_sign of kind school_crossing (not an end sign) whose conditions hold now; asm.school_in_session_day true, asm.school_outside_operation_margin false; no dev.speed_limit_beacon governs the lane; kin.speed is well above the stated 25 miles per hour.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same zone and declarations as forbid; kin.speed is below the stated 25 miles per hour at every observation.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The motor vehicle travels above the stated figure on a lane that no dev.zone_sign of kind school_crossing governs.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Same zone and declarations as forbid, but the source declares kin.speed absent.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A dev.speed_limit_beacon that is not inoperative governs the zone's lane; asm.pupils_in_class true; the beacon is not flashing; the motor vehicle exceeds the stated figure: exception (c) holds.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: Same as branch_1 but the beacon is flashing: exceptions (c) and (d) fail; the motor vehicle exceeds the stated figure.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: No beacon governs the zone's lane; prim.conditions_hold is false for the school crossing zone sign; the motor vehicle exceeds the stated figure: exception (d) holds.

scenarios.name: branch_4
scenarios.narrative: asm.school_outside_operation_margin true; the motor vehicle exceeds the stated figure in the zone: exception (b) holds.
